title: Kronos
tagline: KRONOS: AI assistant tracking wallet activity & verifying on-chain quests with instant rewards
description:
KRONOS – AI-Powered Web3 Wallet & Quest Assistant

KRONOS is a Web3-focused AI assistant designed to help users monitor their wallet activity, explore on-chain transactions, and complete blockchain-based quests. The system leverages real-time data from Blockscout MCP to provide accurate on-chain context, including ETH balances, token holdings, and NFT collections.

Users can interact with KRONOS via a chat interface, where the AI summarizes recent wallet activity, highlights incoming/outgoing transactions, and provides beginner-friendly explanations of their on-chain interactions.

In addition to monitoring, KRONOS supports quest verification, such as tracking swaps on Uniswap or other on-chain actions. Verified quest completions can trigger rewards in PYUSD, enabling seamless micro-rewards for educational or gamified interactions.

The platform is fully integrated with MetaMask for wallet authentication and operates on the Sepolia testnet for safe experimentation. It combines AI intelligence, blockchain data, and gamified incentives to create a friendly, interactive, and educational Web3 experience.

Key features include:

Wallet Activity Insights: Summaries of balances, tokens, NFTs, and transaction history.

On-Chain Quest Verification: Automatic verification of actions like swaps or token interactions.

AI Guidance: KRONOS provides explanations, trends, and personalized advice.

Rewards System: PYUSD rewards for verified actions to incentivize participation.

Secure and Beginner-Friendly: Works with users’ wallets without exposing private keys.
how_its_made:
KRONOS is a Web3 AI assistant designed to make blockchain interactions understandable, interactive, and rewarding. Many users struggle to track wallet activity, verify smart contract interactions, or understand token holdings. KRONOS solves this by summarizing on-chain activity, guiding users through educational quests, and providing real-world micro-rewards.

Users connect their wallets via MetaMask, and KRONOS fetches verified on-chain data using the Blockscout MCP API. This includes balances, token and NFT counts, and transaction history. By leveraging Blockscout, the project ensures trustworthy and decentralized verification, critical for safely educating users about blockchain activity.

The reward system integrates PayPal PYUSD, allowing users to earn real-world incentives for completing on-chain quests. PayPal was specifically chosen because it is a trusted, globally recognized payment platform, which helps users feel secure when receiving rewards. This builds confidence in the system and bridges the gap between on-chain activity and real-world value, making Web3 more accessible and practical for beginners.

The AI chat, powered by Groq’s LLM, provides personalized, context-aware guidance. Users receive clear summaries of recent transactions, token holdings, and trends in their wallet activity. The AI also explains blockchain concepts in simple terms and guides users through quests, creating an engaging learning experience.

Technology Stack:

Frontend: React + TypeScript with Tailwind CSS for responsive, interactive UI

Blockchain Interaction: ethers.js for smart contract calls and reward distribution

AI: Groq LLM for context-aware guidance

Wallet & Network: MetaMask + Sepolia Testnet

On-Chain Data: Blockscout MCP API

Rewards: PayPal PYUSD

KRONOS is not just an AI chat or a wallet tracker—it’s a full-stack learning assistant. By combining verified on-chain data, AI guidance, and trusted, real-world rewards, it addresses the key hurdles in Web3 adoption: understanding and motivation, enabling users to explore, verify, and earn safely in the blockchain ecosystem.
